notes.title: Holiday Update 1.16.0
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39682354/4d7379152a978dfba097b41f1bbd3c11418cf6af.png

Ho-ho-hold the lettuce and pass the turkey and mashed potatoes!

For a limited time during the holiday season, the cabin will have its halls decked with seasonal decorations and the Creative mode will offer delicious holiday meals and recipes, and even a special visit from ole Santa himself -- and his reindeer pals of course! So put on your holiday aprons and get ready to fill St. Nick and his friends’ bellies during a quick break from their gift-delivering journey.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39682354/b19c8a1361b6eed2d0f66148abca0ac646d52300.png

1.16.0 Patch Notes

 Added a seasonal holiday theme! Enjoy the snowy season with updated environments and a festive soundtrack!
 Meet Santa and his reindeer in Creative mode!
 Restored the word "cheese" that had mysteriously vanished from all recipe names and hints.
 Improved the fidelity of the lighting in the cabin.

notes.title: Cook-Out Patch 1.15.1 - Error Tracking
notes.notes:
Hello Cook-Out fans!

To make it easier for the dev team to pinpoint the cause of issues in the game going forward, this patch 1.15.1 adds additional error tracking to the game. 

Please submit a support request to us https://resolutiongames.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/requests/new if you face any issues in the game, to make it easier for our dev team to help you and improve the game.

Full patch notes for patch 1.15.1:

 Added additional error tracking.
 Fixed player rotation being offset slightly to the left after recentering.
 Fixed Spender achievement not being awarded on Steam.
 Fixed French being used instead of Spanish in the user reporting menu.

notes.title: Temporary Patch Reversion — Lost Progress Hotfix — Permanent Fix in the Works
notes.notes:
This patch reverts the previous patch from last week (https://steamcommunity.com/games/1523720/announcements/detail/3747617344196555415) completely.

As reported by users, the previous patch resulted in seemingly lost in-game progress, for which we are deeply sorry.

We can confirm however that all save data still remains intact; the location where it's stored has simply changed. We have therefore released this temporary reversion patch to allow you to access your old save from before the previous patch again. Any save data from after said patch is however unavailable now instead.

Thank you all for your patience!

Dear Chefs,

this update contains mainly a couple of minor bug fixes, which together should create a more stable experience.

Good luck cooking!

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.14
notes.notes:
Hi Chefs,

We have added in-game user reporting. You can access the option from a button in the wrist menu in multiplayer session which will show a list of users participating. In case of misbehavior, select a user and follow the quick steps for reporting.

Exiting the multiplayer session will preserve the list of users participating which means that you can report a user after the session has ended.

We wish you an even happier cooking!

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.13
notes.notes:
Hi Chefs,

We released a game patch that will enhance your experience when interacting with players on different platforms. You can also now manually adjust your hand position to better match your controllers. Please update your app for the changes to apply.

We can’t wait to ketchup with you in the Cook-Out kitchen.

Happy cooking!

notes.title: Game Update: Make it Your Way
notes.notes:
Upgrade your chef’s look with these excellent options. We just released brand new customizations for your animal chef avatar. Choose your skin, outfit and hat to be the sharpest-looking chef in the kitchen.
  
We’ve also added more than 40 achievements. Put your skills to the test to unlock special rewards including a new animal chef avatar.

New Features:
Customize your Cook-Out Avatar

 Added options for hats, shirts and gloves
 Your favorite animal avatar can now have different skin variations
 Check out your look in the new mirror as you customize your animal avatar

New Animal Avatar

 How to unlock it is for us to know and you to find out 

Achievements

 More than 40+ achievements to unlock
 Some are really tricky, and by unlocking some you will unlock new customization options.

New Main Menu

 Updated the way the main menu looks, isn't it fancy

Bug fixes:
Fixed bugs and improved overall stability
